summary_rationale: Zydus Lifesciences earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS on its diversified, high-gross-margin (~73.1%) healthcare franchise: a top-5 India Formulations business (~57% chronic/sub-chronic, growing 19-20% YoY in H1 FY27), a 44% North America platform transitioning from limited-competition generics into rare-disease specialty (ZYCUBO FDA-approved Jan 2026) and proprietary NCEs (Saroglitazar PBC NDA under FDA Priority Review with Nov 27, 2026 PDUFA), plus rapidly scaling Consumer Wellness (15% mix) and International Markets (11% mix), all delivering 21.1% ROCE in FY26. kpi_health is set to PASS_WITH_WATCH due to four active transition watchpoints: (1) USFDA cGMP remediation at Moraiya (5 Form 483 observations in Oct 2026) and Baddi (June 2026 Warning Letter); (2) the Sept 2027 Mirabegron patent cliff and gRevlimid tapering compressing FY27 OPM from 31.2% toward ~24%; (3) FY26 CFO/EBITDA dropping to 44% with Inventory Days at 282; and (4) gross debt rising to ₹13,966 Cr (Sep 2026, 0.62x Net Debt/EBITDA) following Amplitude Surgical, Comfort Click, Naturell, and Assertio M&A.
